items.title: Google's Gemini glasses open for preorder at $395
items.takeaway: Hands-free translation and directions could help crews in the field. At $395 and up, wait for real reviews before you buy for a team.

items.title: ChatGPT's custom GPTs retire on December 11
items.takeaway: If your team runs on a custom GPT, move it to a plugin or a project and test it now. Custom actions don't carry over.

items.title: Businesses can now claim their profile in ChatGPT
items.takeaway: Claim it and correct your hours, prices and service area. The customer-chat agents are limited to U.S. online sellers for now.

items.title: Claude adds Sheets, Whiteboards and a meeting note-taker
items.takeaway: Try it before renewing a separate tracker. Sheets is a basic beta, and Meetings is only on Team and Enterprise plans.

items.title: Stolen AI keys ran up $740,000 after a Railway breach
items.takeaway: If an app or host stores your AI key, rotate it and set a spending cap. A leaked key bills you, not the thief.

items.title: Intuit starts a free 30-city AI tour for small businesses
items.takeaway: Free hands-on time with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Expect a QuickBooks pitch alongside the training.
